sub_threshold_definition: A candidate is sub_threshold when it is not promotable and fails to move its pre-registered component or paired end-to-end confidence gate. Component attribution or a delta below the remaining kill-number is not product progress. Mark sub_threshold=true explicitly; the validator counts the flag and does not re-derive the result.
switch_rule: Per family: >=2 consecutive sub_threshold candidates require a switch_decision whose seq_covered >= the family's max candidate seq, else validate_repo.py fails. Switching = pop the active route, push the highest-rank parked_route. Escalation to user counts as a switch decision only when the next step genuinely needs a user call (target/backend choice, ch.1).
